questions.description: אילו היו נערכות בחירות היום למי היית מצביע?
questions.notes: NOT a national sample - online survey of readers of the 'Srugim' (national-religious) website. Table has no seat column; gives raw respondent counts (ש"ס 160, יהדות התורה 30, הציונות הדתית/עוצמה יהודית 2398, הליכוד 888, הבית היהודי 921, ישראל ביתנו 18, המחנה הממלכתי 112, יש עתיד 37, העבודה 5, מרצ 10, רע"מ 1, חד"ש/תע"ל 2, בל"ד 5, לא אצביע 25, אחר 228; total 4840) and rounded pct. The pct column does not match the raw counts (e.g. Likud 888/4840=18% but shown 25%; Habayit Hayehudi 921 shown 17%) so pct appears weighted/adjusted by the pollster; recorded as printed. 'לא אצביע בבחירות הקרובות' 25 respondents = 0%; 'אחר' 228 = 6%.

extraction_notes: Page 1 is the CEC disclosure form (appendix C): commissioner Srugim website, pollster 'נתוני אמת' institute, fieldwork 22-28.9.2022, internet questionnaire, initial sample 6,461, total participants 12,384 of whom 47.8% did not fit the survey, no margin of error stated. Respondents recorded as 4,840 = sum of the table's respondent counts. No seat figures; pct sums to 99 due to rounding. Both pages clear.
